Scope: Typed, canonical, read-only MediaWiki category metadata and source-only index planning; no durable category persistence or full category-page parity claim.

ImplementedBehavior.TypedDirective: MediaWikiCategory retains source title, offset, normalized title, canonical Category:: navigation, sort key, provenance, and Membership classification.
ImplementedBehavior.CanonicalIdentity: Existing TwNamespaceNavigation rules are reused; invalid identities produce InvalidCategoryTitle.
ImplementedBehavior.ExplicitCategoryLinks: Leading-colon Category links remain links and do not create membership metadata.
ImplementedBehavior.Deduplication: Canonical navigation plus ordinal sort key; exact repeats collapse deterministically.
ImplementedBehavior.Transclusion: Resolved direct and reached nested-template directives are exposed after expansion; selected conditional branches only.
ImplementedBehavior.IndexPlan: MediaWikiCategoryIndexPlanner creates an immutable, ordered, source-only plan and never writes storage.
ImplementedBehavior.IncompleteExpansion: Missing/restricted/unsupported/recursive/runtime/budget diagnostics set PreserveExistingMembership and prohibit replacement.
ImplementedBehavior.HistoricalRendering: No mutation path exists; historical rendering cannot update current membership.

DatabaseTests.Note: No category schema or authorized disposable category database was available; skipped database tests are not passes.

NewRegressionCoverage: Incomplete template expansion preserves existing membership
Explicit leading-colon category link remains non-membership

RemainingBlockers: Authorized disposable category schema and repository contract
Transactional provider integration at page-save/import boundaries
Bounded category-member query with stable pagination
Existing page visibility policy applied to category listings
Category MVC route/view and empty/missing states
Historical category evidence and MediaWiki parity
RecommendedNextMilestone: Obtain explicit authorization and design evidence for a disposable category persistence/visibility slice before adding schema, repository, query, or MVC integration.
